snippet.title: BASED - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4015070/BASED/

BASED is a co-op platformer where you combo the Moon to the sky every night. Master movement and weapons to rise the Moon in one piece. Who knows what secrets you'll find on your way up. Join B.A.S.E.D. tonight!
